records.findings_summary: Flag found via Recovered the janitor-deleted post from the SunChan board SQLite WAL inside the GhostInTheThread forensic VM (OVA downloaded from the Google Drive link). The leak the mods cleaned up reads: 2026-08-07T15:42:19Z 'I HAVE PROOF THAT MOOT WENT TO MOOTXICO' -> the vacation location 'mootxico'. Platform confirmed 'mootxico' as Correct.: mootxico | Evidence: metadata.yml: native_id 30, name 'ghost in the thread - 3', challenge_url https://2026.sunshinectf.org/challenges#ghost%20in%20the%20thread%20-%203-30 ; Google Drive link resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,945,280 B) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (2 GiB streamOptimized sparse extent, magic KDMV, compress=1, flags=0x30003 / has grain markers) ; Wrote a parser (vmdk2raw.py): each grain at GTE sector starts with a 12-byte marker (uint64 LBA + uint32 zlib length) then a zlib stream; decoded all 3596 non-zero grains into disk.raw (2 GiB) ; GPT disk: root ext4 partition starts at sector 135168 (mmls); fls -o 135168 disk.raw lists /var/lib/sunchan/board.sqlite (inode 65421) + board.sqlite-wal (65420) and /srv/sunchan/uploads/po/184726.pdf (892 B, PostScript) ; board.sqlite moderation_actions shows 16 posts on board 'po' deleted 2026-08-07 with reason 'off-topic or sensitive information' (ids 183901..183989); the deleted rows no longer exist in the main DB but survive in board.sqlite-wal
solution_steps: 从 Google Drive 链接下载 GhostInTheThread.ova（处理大文件的 confirm/uuid 二次确认）。
解包 OVA 得到 GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk（streamOptimized 稀疏盘）。7z/qemu-img 不可用，故自己写 vmdk2raw.py：按 GD/GT 定位每个 grain，grain 起始是 12 字节 marker(LBA+压缩长度)，随后是 zlib 流；逐个解压还原出 2GB 的 disk.raw。
用 mmls 解析 GPT，根 ext4 分区起始扇区 135168；用 fls/icat -o 135168 读取文件。

提取 /var/lib/sunchan/board.sqlite 及其 -wal：moderation_actions 记录了 2026-08-07 被“janitor（版主）”删除的 16 个 /po/ 帖子（post 183901..183989，理由 off-topic or sensitive information）。主库中这些行已不存在，但仍残留在 board.sqlite-wal 的页镜像里。
扫描 WAL 恢复被删正文，得到泄漏帖 2026-08-07T15:42:19Z：“I HAVE PROOF THAT MOOT WENT TO MOOTXICO”，即 moot 的度假地点为 mootxico。
在平台提交 'mootxico'（全小写）→ 页面显示 Correct，题目被标记 Solved，确认 flag。
evidence: metadata.yml: native_id 30, name 'ghost in the thread - 3', challenge_url https://2026.sunshinectf.org/challenges#ghost%20in%20the%20thread%20-%203-30

Google Drive link resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,945,280 B) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (2 GiB streamOptimized sparse extent, magic KDMV, compress=1, flags=0x30003 / has grain markers)
Wrote a parser (vmdk2raw.py): each grain at GTE sector starts with a 12-byte marker (uint64 LBA + uint32 zlib length) then a zlib stream; decoded all 3596 non-zero grains into disk.raw (2 GiB)

GPT disk: root ext4 partition starts at sector 135168 (mmls); fls -o 135168 disk.raw lists /var/lib/sunchan/board.sqlite (inode 65421) + board.sqlite-wal (65420) and /srv/sunchan/uploads/po/184726.pdf (892 B, PostScript)

board.sqlite moderation_actions shows 16 posts on board 'po' deleted 2026-08-07 with reason 'off-topic or sensitive information' (ids 183901..183989); the deleted rows no longer exist in the main DB but survive in board.sqlite-wal
wal_recover.py enumerates the WAL page images and prints the deleted bodies; the only leak is 2026-08-07T15:42:19Z 'I HAVE PROOF THAT MOOT WENT TO MOOTXICO'
Platform: submitting 'mootxico' on challenge #30 returned alert 'Correct'; challenge list then showed 'ghost in the thread - 3 ✦ Solved 467 164 solves' (solved 24/37)
Note: 'Mootxico' (mixed case) was Incorrect and 'Mexico' was Incorrect; the accepted flag is the all-lowercase 'mootxico'
